feeds.notes:

Saved the same way: type=SWPAR 'State' (Governor only; resultsSW-SWPAR.html 37313 bytes), SENATE (15 contests; 184292), HOUSE (30 contests seen, districts 1-30; 335581), SWNON 'Nonpartisan' (judges, district attorneys; 123461), MCR 'Shared County, City And District Races And Measures' (866234), LMEA 'Local Measure' (772561). Responses carry cache-control: public, max-age=60. Markup per contest:

feeds.what: the office's export page (CSV / Excel / RSS / XML of Statewide, Governor, Legislative, Statewide Nonpartisan, and per-county). NOT usable read-only
feeds.notes: Only the GET of the page was done (saved). Every export link is an ASP.NET postback (javascript:__doPostBack('ctl00$MainContent$Statewide','') etc.) that must POST the form with __VIEWSTATE / __EVENTVALIDATION and the chosen format radio ctl00$MainContent$rblTypes (1 CSV, 2 Excel, 3 RSS, 4 XML). The brief forbids submitting forms, so no export was downloaded and its columns are unknown. No GET equivalent found.

election_id: None in the URLs: the site shows the current election (header: 'November 3, 2026', 'Unofficial'). The page's JS reads an optional ?eid=<number> query parameter for other elections; no value for this election was seen.
discovery: Nothing to discover for the current election (fixed URLs). A list of past elections is at https://results.oregonvotes.gov/ResultsList.aspx (linked from the page, not fetched).
bot_blocking: None seen: 200 with the relay User-Agent on every page (Cloudflare/Azure front; sets an ASP.NET_SessionId cookie that was not needed). CAVEAT about this machine only: Git Bash curl 8.8.0 (Schannel) fails on this host with 'curl: (43) A libcurl function was given a bad argument' (as on North Dakota's and Ohio's hosts), so pages and .headers.txt were fetched with Python urllib sending the relay User-Agent and Origin header; the headers files were written by that script, not curl -D. Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.

The header also shows ballots counted (1,924,959) and Active Registered Voters (3,109,082).

tried: https://results.oregonvotes.gov/ : curl error 43 locally; Python urllib with the relay User-Agent: 200, BPro TotalVote, 'November 3, 2026', 'Unofficial'
/ResultsExport.aspx: 200, but every export is a __doPostBack form POST; not submitted
/resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=SW&map=CTY (the GET export New Mexico's BPro site has): redirects to /ErrorPages/Error.aspx here
Headless Chrome on resultsSW.aspx?type=FED: no JSON/XML/CSV requests at all; results are in the HTML (the page's own analytics beacons fired, nothing else)

The page names an ajax host, https://orresultswebservices.azureedge.us/ (ResultsAjax.svc/GetCandidates?ElectionType=General&ElectionID=0 for the search box; CreateMap()/BuildCounty() for per-contest county data); its Scripts/utils.js has no .svc paths, and I did not probe the service further

Fetched the seven resultsSW.aspx type pages: 199 contests in total. Open points, hence 'medium': the HOUSE page lists only districts 1-30 (Oregon has 60) with no paging control found, and there is no statewide-measure or other-statewide-office type in the menu, so none were seen
